description_en: Modifies the basic configuration of a specified address, such as the address name, type, and value
description_zh: 调用 UpdateCloudGtmAddress 修改指定地址基础配置
name: UpdateCloudGtmAddress

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US（默认）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the address
parameters.help_zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码
parameters.name: address_id

parameters.help_en: The updated name of the address
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The updated IP address or domain name
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的IP地址或者域名
parameters.name: address

parameters.example: 当前版本不支持此参数，不需要传入此参数。
parameters.help_en: The attribution information of the address
parameters.name: attribute_info

parameters.help_en:
The updated condition for determining the health status of the address:

any_ok: At least one probe is normal for all health check templates.

p30_ok: At least 30% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

p50_ok: At least 50% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

p70_ok: At least 70% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

all_ok: All probes are normal for all health check templates
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的地址健康状态判定条件：

any_ok：所有探测模板至少一个探测正常。

p30_ok：所有探测模板至少30%探测正常。

p50_ok：所有探测模板至少50%探测正常。

p70_ok：所有探测模板至少70%探测正常。

all_ok：所有探测模板全部探测正常
parameters.name: health_judgement

fields.help_en:
The service port of the target address for the health check. You cannot configure a service port if the health check uses the ping protocol.

If you leave this parameter empty, the currently configured port is deleted.

If you specify a value for this parameter, the port is updated to the specified value
fields.help_zh:
健康检查探测的目标地址服务端口，当健康检查选择Ping协议时，不支持服务端口的配置。

传入参数为空：删除当前已配置的端口号；

传入参数不为空：根据传入参数更新端口号；
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The ID of the health check template associated with the address. This parameter is required if you configure a health check port.

If you leave this parameter empty, the currently configured health check template is deleted.

If you specify a value for this parameter, the health check template is updated to the specified value
fields.help_zh:
地址关联的健康探测模板ID。如果配置了健康检查的端口号，此参数必填。

传入参数为空：删除当前已配置的探测模板；

传入参数不为空：根据传入参数更新探测模板；
fields.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The list of health check tasks
parameters.name: health_tasks

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful.

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
修改地址基础配置操作是否成功：

true：操作成功

false：操作失败
